description:
When the red flags stop feeling sexy or enticing, that’s when you know you’re healing. For so many of us with trauma, the past becomes the present—replaying the same patterns, mistaking chaos for connection, and intensity for love. But when you finally break that cycle, it means you’ve outgrown the chaos and no longer need the highs and lows to feel alive. You can’t get there if you’re still stuck in the loop of fights and emotional intensity. True healing comes when you crave peace over drama and realize that real love is built on safety, not survival mode.

The Sabrina Zohar Show EP 102 with @drscottlyons on the highs and lows in dating and relationships out now! Available on Spotify, Apple, YouTube and anywhere you listen to your podcasts! 

Comment 📺 to get a link to watch the new episode on YouTube!!

transcript: When the red flags are no longer attractive is when you're healing. And when you can move past the layer of like, I'm bored and this is okay. You actually get into the nuance and the flavors of relationship, which is so rich and so full of life. But you can't get to it if you're constantly in the cycle of drama, essentially, where it's fights and it's intensity and it's stories and narratives that you're creating. And those addicted to drama can't actually decipher between the narratives we make up around someone and the interpretations we default to and what's actually here in the present moment. The past is the present for so many of us with trauma and we're enacting it out here and now in this relationship.
